howToBook.heading: Ntuma nshobora gutumiza bisi?
howToBook.body: Fungura Ahabanza, hitamo umujyi uva, aho ujya, n'itariki. Hitamo bisi ku rutonde kande utume. Umuyobozi azemeza gutumiza kandi ashira ifoto y'itike mu masaha make.

serviceFee.heading: Serivisi y'amafaranga ikora ite?
serviceFee.body: Jali ifata 300-500 RWF ku gutumiza buri yose hashingiwe ku ntera uva kuri station ya bisi ya hafi. Aya mafaranga yishyura ibikorwa byacu kandi agaragara neza mbere yo kwishyura.

receiveTicket.heading: Nzabona itike ryari?
receiveTicket.body: Nyuma yo gutumiza, itsinda ryacu rihuza n'isosiyete ya bisi rikaguha itike. Dufata ifoto y'itike tuyishira kuri booking yawe — bisanzwe mu masaha 2-4. Uzabona ubutumwa bw'itike irateguye.

cancelBooking.heading: Nshobora gusiba gutumiza?
cancelBooking.body: Gutumiza bisi bishobora gusibwa amasaha 24 mbere y'urugendo kugira ngo ubashe gusubizwa. Ahicaye bwite ntibishobora gusubizwa — umushoferi aba yatse umwanya mbere. Gukodesha imodoka bishingiye ku gihe gisigaye.

paymentMethods.heading: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura buboneka?
paymentMethods.body: Ubu dukoresha MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money, n'ikadi ya banki. Kwishyura bizaboneka mu minsi iri imbere. Gutumiza byemejwe nyuma yo kwishyura.

becomeDriver.heading: Naba umushoferi nte?
becomeDriver.body: Jya kuri Profile ukoraneho Uburyo bwo Gutwara. Uzashobora gutanga imyanya bwite ku nzira zawe ukwinjiza n'abagenzi. Amakuru y'imodoka n'akarere ushobora kubishira kuri Dashboard.

contactSupport.heading: Ntuma mvugisha support?
contactSupport.body: Kanda ku Bufasha & Support muri Profile yawe. Urashobora kutwandikira kuri WhatsApp cyangwa guhamagara mu masaha y'akazi (8am-6pm, Kuwa Mbere-Kuwa Gatandatu). Dushaka gusubiza mu isaha 1.

outsideKigali.heading: Jali ikora hanze ya Kigali?
outsideKigali.body: Yego. Jali ikora inzira hagati ya Kigali, Musanze, Huye, Rubavu, Nyagatare, Rwamagana, Muhanga, na Rusizi. Imijyi myinshi izongerwa hashingiwe ku busabe.

acceptance.heading: 1. Kwemera
acceptance.body: Ukoresha Jali, wemeye aya Mabwiriza. Ntabyo wemera, ntukoreshe app. Aya mabwiriza akora ku bakoresha bose harimo abagenzi, abashoferi, n'abayobozi.

eligibility.heading: 2. Ubushobozi
eligibility.body: Ugomba kuba ufite imyaka 18 nibura kugira ngo ukoreshe Jali. Ufungura konti wemeje ko ujuje ibi bisabwa.

bookings.heading: 3. Gutumiza
bookings.body: Jali ikora nk'ihuza ry'ibisabwa. Dutegura ubwikorezi bwawe binyuze mu masosiyete y'abashoferi n'abashoferi bwite. Kwemezwa bishingiye ku mwanya uboneka.

serviceFee.heading: 4. Serivisi y'Amafaranga
serviceFee.body: Serivisi y'amafaranga ya 300-500 RWF ntisubizwa ku gutumiza buri yose. Aya mafaranga yishyura ibikorwa bya platform kandi agaragara mbere yo kwishyura.

cancellations.heading: 5. Gusiba & Gusubizwa
cancellations.body: Gutumiza bisi byasibwe amasaha 24 mbere y'urugendo kugira ngo ubashe gusubizwa (serivisi idasubizwa). Ahicaye bwite ntibisubizwa nyuma yo kwemezwa. Gukodesha imodoka ntibisubizwa mu masaha 12 y'itangira.

driverResponsibilities.heading: 6. Inshingano z'Umushoferi
driverResponsibilities.body: Abashoferi batanga imyanya bwite binyuze kuri Jali ni abakora bwite. Bashinzwe imodoka yabo, ubwishingizi, no kubahiriza amategeko y'ubwikorezi mu Rwanda.

prohibitedUse.heading: 7. Gukoresha bidatemewe
prohibitedUse.body: Ntugomba gukoresha Jali mu bikorwa bitemewe n'amategeko, gusuzugura abandi bakoresha, gutumiza impimbano, cyangwa kugerageza kwinjira muri konti y'undi mukoresha.

limitationOfLiability.heading: 8. Kugabanya Inshingano
limitationOfLiability.body: Jali ntibazwa gukererwa, gusiba, cyangwa impanuka ziterwa n'abashoferi b'indi sosiyete. Duhuza gutumiza ariko ntidutwara imodoka.

changesToTerms.heading: 9. Impinduka mu Mabwiriza
changesToTerms.body: Dushobora guhindura aya Mabwiriza igihe cyose. Gukoresha app nyuma y'impinduka bisobanura ko wemeye. Tuzakumenyesha impinduka zikomeye binyuze kuri notification.

governingLaw.heading: 10. Amategeko agenga
governingLaw.body: Aya Mabwiriza agengwa n'amategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda.

whatWeCollect.heading: Ibyo dukusanya
whatWeCollect.body: Dukusanya numero yawe ya telefoni cyangwa email ya konti Google (kugira ngo winjire), izina ryawe, aho uherereye (kubara serivisi), amateka y'ibisabwa, na token ya notification y'igikoresho cyawe (kukohereza amakuru).

howWeUse.heading: Uko dukoresha amakuru yawe
howWeUse.body: Amakuru yawe akoreshwa kugira ngo: dutegure kandi ducunge ibisabwa byawe, tubare serivisi hashingiwe ku ntera, twohereze notification ku bisabwa byawe, n'iterambere rya serivisi ya Jali. Ntidutunza amakuru yawe.

location.heading: Aho uherereye
location.body: Jali isaba aho uherereye gusa kugira ngo ibare serivisi hashingiwe ku ntera uva kuri station ya bisi ya hafi. Aho uherereye ntibubikwa kuri server zacu kandi ntibisangirwa n'abandi.

firebase.heading: Firebase
firebase.body: Jali ikoresha Google Firebase kugira ngo yemeze konti no kohereza notification. Firebase ishobora gutunganya numero yawe ya telefoni cyangwa email kuri server za Google. Reba Politiki y'Ibanga ya Google.

dataStorage.heading: Kubika amakuru
dataStorage.body: Amakuru ya konti yawe n'ibisabwa bibikwa kuri server zacu zizewe ziri mu Burayi (Hetzner). Amafoto y'itike abikwa muri Google Firebase Storage.

dataRetention.heading: Kugumisha amakuru
dataRetention.body: Amakuru yawe agumishwa igihe konti yawe ihari. Usibye konti yawe, amakuru yawe y'ibanga akurwa burundu mu minsi 30. Amakuru y'ibisabwa atazwi arashobora kugumishwa.

yourRights.heading: Uburenganzira bwawe
yourRights.body: Ufite uburenganzira bwo kugera, gukosora, cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe igihe cyose. Urashobora gusiba konti yawe muri app → Profile → Siba Konti. Kugira ngo ubaze ibindi, twandikira privacy@jali.rw.

children.heading: Abana
children.body: Jali ntabwo igenewe abakoresha bafite imyaka munsi ya 18. Ntidukusanya amakuru y'abana n'ubushake.

contact.heading: Twandikire
contact.body: Kubibazo by'ibanga, twandikira privacy@jali.rw cyangwa wandike: Jali, Kigali, u Rwanda.

lastUpdated.body: Iyi politiki yavuguruwe bwa nyuma ku ya 6 Mata 2026.
